# BioSyncLabs

> Germany-based supplier of research-grade peptides and bioscience compounds for licensed laboratory and academic research. All products are sold strictly for Research Use Only (RUO) — not for human consumption, diagnostic, or therapeutic use.

## About BioSyncLabs

BioSyncLabs (biosynclabs.eu) is a EU-registered life-science supply company headquartered in Germany. We supply synthetic lyophilized peptides and research biochemicals to academic institutions, contract research organisations (CROs), and licensed laboratories across the European Union.

Every product batch is independently tested by a third-party ISO-accredited laboratory via HPLC and LC-MS and verified to ≥99% purity. A Certificate of Analysis (CoA) accompanies every order. We do not sell to private consumers and our products are not intended for, and must not be used in, any procedure involving humans or animals.

## Legal & Compliance

- All products are Research Use Only (RUO) — strictly for in-vitro / laboratory research
- Not for human consumption, therapeutic, clinical, or diagnostic use
- Compliant with German chemical and pharmaceutical supply regulations
- No prescription required for legitimate laboratory research use in Germany and the EU
- Buyers are responsible for compliance with local regulations in their jurisdiction
- We ship exclusively within the European Union
